transcript: Last night my boyfriend Paul and I went to the Classical Theater of Harlem production of Malvolio and Marcus Garvey Park. Similar to the public's annual Shakespeare and Central Park, this production is also outdoors at a public park and is completely free to attend. Malvolio is a contemporary sequel to Shakespeare. 12th Night, 12th Night. Mavolio was Olivia Stewart who fell for a forged love letter for community purposes. In this play, he's now a military general with a potential love letter related redemption arc. This play is light hearted, it's funny, and it's very playfully directed. The design elements are splashing, particularly the costumes and the projections, and the performances feel earnest and spontaneous. Malvolio is running through the end of July for free, so don't miss it. But do bring an umbrella just in case. With that, another program for my collection.
